claim: Identical original point wrenches permit different admissible traction distributions and different stress predictions
caption: Opposing0.05N patches, radius3mm and friction2. All displayed alternative profiles preserve the original six-component patch wrenches and use byte-identical rigid inputs. The peak chart retains every raw global corner maximum. The full3D stress maps use a shared scale and exact face-centroid tensors for display; stars identify unaveraged global corner maxima. Pressure maps retain quadrature samples with matched colour limits and physical coordinates. Native input/profile is unchanged. These are fixed-discretization model comparisons, not continuum or contact-feedback validation.
open_issues: Coulomb admissibility is sampled; complete mesh/contact convergence and resolved egg/Franka comparisons remain required.
